owner_request_2026_11_16_voice.statement_summary: Songs would not start and the voice level slider did not show. Then: playback works after all (the owner's correction, with a screenshot); the slider is still missing. Chosen: the slider on every song.
owner_request_2026_11_16_voice.playback: not reproduced and not changed: the owner confirmed playback works; AudioChainPlaybackTest gained a separated title played through the voice stage, and RowTapHostTest checks that a tap on a row plays it on a phone and in a large window

done.slider_everywhere: VoiceSlider(trackId) shown on every title of the lyrics screen with the controls (never in full-screen lyrics)
done.on_demand: VoiceSeparation reads the title with MediaExtractor from its download or the address the playback service loaded (not DASH/HLS), separates it whole with the quick model when present (StemLibrary.separateWhole, the library pausing meanwhile), and offers the quick model's download (39 MB) when no model is there
done.applied_at_once: PlaybackService.takeUpVoice gives the playing deck the new separation and re-seeks to the same position so that the voice stage starts; with voiceLevel < 100 each new title is separated as it starts

not_validated: physical phone or Quest installation, rendering and touch behaviour
on-demand separation on a device: time per song, battery, memory, reading a streamed address with MediaExtractor (headers, expiring links), the model download from the slider
the re-seek that applies a fresh separation: whether it is heard on a stream
the voice level's audio quality and CPU cost on the audio thread
independent code review of this diff
known_limitations: A song is separated the first time its voice slider is touched; the time depends on the phone and the song.
Streams made of many small files (DASH, HLS) cannot be read whole: those songs must be downloaded to adjust their voice.
A streamed song is downloaded a second time by the separation.
Separated songs play about 0.09 s later than they otherwise would, at every voice level.
Being a beta tag, the in-app updater does not offer it to users of a stable version; it is offered on the website and the releases page.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
